name: Julius
subtitle: Site Reliability Engineer · Instructor · Designer · Chicago
description: **Your production has to stay boring.** Services multiply, the toil piles up, on-call gets heavy — and now everyone wants AI in the loop without it breaking things.

That's been my work for fifteen years: keeping systems calm — 170+ services and an automation platform running ~1.6M jobs a year at 99.6% — building the guardrails and self-service tooling that let teams move fast, and teaching engineers to do the same. I came up as a designer, so I sweat how a system *feels* to use, not just whether it's up.
Bring me the messy, high-stakes parts. **You keep shipping; I'll keep it reliable.**
